business_problem: As a global leader in audit, tax, and advisory services, KPMG faced a challenge: the need to manage and analyze data from a myriad of clients.
solution_summary: KPMG modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft OneLake, Power BI, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. "We're excited by the opportunity to use our in-house experience to help clients harness the capabilities of Microsoft Fabric to analyze data at scale, taking advantage of key features such as robust data governance and security capabilities, Microsoft OneLake for centralized data access, and Microsoft Power BI for reporting."
